reason_summary: Class-weighted training improved defect recall and macro F1 compared with CNN v0.2.0, but false positives remain high.
improvement_summary: Defect recall improved from 0.0 to 0.7842105263157895; defect F1 improved from 0.0 to 0.44345238095238093; macro F1 improved from 0.43290960451977406 to 0.5215120577138779.
remaining_risks: 333 good validation samples were predicted as defect.
Model requires additional review before any deployment claim.
safe_wording: Track A CNN v0.3.0 completed real controlled 20-epoch full-epoch class-weighted training with original runtime logs. Compared with CNN v0.2.0, defect recall improved from 0.0 to 0.7842 and macro F1 improved from 0.4329 to 0.5215. However, the model is not production-ready because it produces many false positives, with 333 good validation samples predicted as defect.
